_note: Fixed equipment categories for the job's overall % complete. Admins set each one's share of the job (Admin -> Completion weights); 'default' is the starting share. A type not listed counts as 'other'. Keep worker/hitlist/data/completion_categories.json identical (a test checks).

categories.label: Outlets & inlets
categories.includes: Supply outlets, return inlets, exhaust inlets

categories.label: Air handlers
categories.includes: AHUs, RTUs, make-up air units, and their fans, coils, electric heat, filters; duct traverses

categories.label: Hydronic
categories.includes: Pumps, chillers, cooling towers, boilers, coil tests, autoflow valves

categories.label: Unitary
categories.includes: FCUs, WSHPs, split and ductless systems, unit heaters

categories.label: Other tests
categories.includes: Temp, flow and pressure sensors, ACH / pressurization, anything else
